description: Load a Chandrayaan-2 source (moving) image and an external reference (fixed) image into one common object model.
acceptance_criteria: Both images load into identical SceneMeta shape; src/ref roles explicit in the API.

description: Ingest OHRC panchromatic pushbroom products, 0.25 m/px GSD, 500-800 nm, TDI CCD.
acceptance_criteria: Real OHRC product (e.g. ch2_ohr_ncp_*_d_img_d18.img, 79796x12000) parses and reads a window.

description: Ingest TMC-2 panchromatic stereo pushbroom products, ~5 m/px (4.43 m/px on real labels), 20 km swath, 3 look angles.
acceptance_criteria: Real TMC-2 label (191483x4000, 4.43 m/px) parses; windowed read succeeds.

description: Ingest IIRS hyperspectral products, ~80 m/px, 0.8-5.0 um, ~250-256 contiguous bands, BSQ/BIL/BIP interleave.
acceptance_criteria: Real IIRS .hdr/.xml parses; band count read from label; single band and cube both readable.

description: Load LRO Narrow Angle Camera products (0.5 m/px) as the reference image. Explicitly named in the PS dataset field.
acceptance_criteria: Real NAC product (e.g. M1404744695RC.IMG) loads into SceneMeta.

description: Load LRO Wide Angle Camera products (~100 m/px). Reachable via the LROC QuickMap link named in the PS.
source: PS Dataset link: LROC QuickMap hosts NAC and WAC
acceptance_criteria: WAC product loads; IIRS<->WAC pair constructible.

description: Load SELENE Terrain Camera PDS3 products (~7.4-10 m/px) as reference. Named generically as 'SELENE Images' in the PS.
acceptance_criteria: Real SELENE TC .img+.lbl parses via the PDS3 path; ^IMAGE byte offset correct.

description: Load SELENE Multiband Imager products (~20-62 m/px). Stretch goal; MI is genuinely unattempted against any CH-2 instrument.
acceptance_criteria: MI product loads into SceneMeta with band metadata.

description: ONE pipeline handling any CH-2 instrument against either reference, not three hand-tuned special cases. The PS asks for a 'generic software solution'.
acceptance_criteria: A single entry point registers all tested pairs with no instrument-specific branch outside the config-driven registry.

description: Detect keypoints in source and reference. Classical (SIFT/AKAZE/ORB/BRISK) plus learned detectors via kornia.
acceptance_criteria: Detector returns keypoints on a real tile; count logged into Metrics.keypoints_src/ref.

description: Describe keypoints. Handcrafted (SIFT 128-D, binary), modality-independent (MIND/RIFT phase-congruency), and learned descriptors.
acceptance_criteria: At least one handcrafted, one modality-independent and one learned descriptor path available and selectable.

description: Match descriptors: BF/FLANN + Lowe ratio test + mutual nearest neighbour as the floor; learned matchers (LightGlue/LoFTR) as the primary path.
acceptance_criteria: Returns a conforming MatchSet; ratio test and MNN both demonstrably filter outliers.

description: Export the corresponding match points as CSV and GeoJSON at sub-pixel precision, with pixel and lat/lon coordinates, confidence and inlier flag.
source: PS deliverable: 'registered product with corresponding match points'
acceptance_criteria: CSV round-trips to MatchSet without precision loss; GeoJSON opens in QGIS with lunar CRS.

description: Estimate the source->reference transform (affine / homography / TPS) robustly via RANSAC / MAGSAC++ / USAC.
source: PS: 'aligning the source image with the reference image'
acceptance_criteria: Recovers a known synthetic homography to <1 px RMSE; MAGSAC beats RANSAC at 70% outliers.

description: Apply the estimated transform to geometrically transform the source image into the reference coordinate system.
source: PS: 'Source Image (Moving): the image that is to be geometrically transformed'
acceptance_criteria: Warped source visually aligns with reference; warp-then-inverse returns within sub-pixel error.

description: Write the registered product as a georeferenced GeoTIFF with correct geotransform and lunar CRS, plus a JSON sidecar carrying both SceneMeta objects, the transform and the metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Output opens in QGIS aligned to the reference; sidecar validates against the contract schema.

description: Refine match points below integer-pixel resolution: quadratic NCC peak fitting, phase-correlation residual shift, cv2.cornerSubPix, and iterative least-squares homography refinement.
source: PS: 'with a sub-pixel accuracy of source image'
acceptance_criteria: Known synthetic shift (0.37,-0.62) recovered to <0.1 px by at least two of the four methods.

description: PROVE sub-pixel accuracy, not just claim it: synthetic self-validation (known sub-pixel shift applied to a real CH-2 image) plus independent DEM-based geometric cross-validation. No public sub-pixel ground truth exists for this combination.
source: PS: 'sub-pixel accuracy'; no public GT benchmark exists
acceptance_criteria: Metrics.subpixel_recovery_err_px populated from a real measurement, with the protocol documented.

description: Enforce uniform spatial distribution of match points: NxN grid partition, per-cell top-k retention, secondary low-threshold pass on empty cells, farthest-point sampling alternative.
source: PS: 'maintaining uniform distribution across the images'
acceptance_criteria: Clustered synthetic match set improves from <0.15 to >0.6 coverage; output resembles the PS's illustrated target, not its failure case.

description: Report spatial coverage quantitatively = fraction of grid cells containing >=1 valid inlier, plus a Delaunay max-gap diagnostic.
source: PS: evaluation metric + uniform distribution mandate
acceptance_criteria: Metrics.spatial_coverage in [0,1]; matches a hand-counted value on a fixture.

description: Root-mean-square residual error of inlier correspondences under the estimated transform, reported in pixels and in metres (px x GSD).
acceptance_criteria: Metrics.rmse_px and rmse_m computed; verified against a hand-calculated fixture.

description: Number of correspondences surviving robust estimation and all filtering stages.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics.inlier_count equals the sum of the inlier mask.

description: Inliers divided by total candidate matches. The headline discriminator between easy and hard pairings in this problem.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics.inlier_ratio in [0,1]; consistent with inlier_count/len(matches).

description: Handle changes in sun azimuth and elevation that alter lunar surface appearance: CLAHE, phase-congruency descriptors, shadow masking, and regime routing driven by the extracted incidence angle.
acceptance_criteria: A pair with >40 deg incidence difference registers successfully where the SIFT baseline fails.

description: Handle geometric distortion from differing camera positions/orientations: homography and TPS models, ASIFT-style affine simulation, orientation sanity checks.
acceptance_criteria: A 60 deg rotated synthetic pair that plain SIFT fails on is recovered.

description: Handle scale ratios from ~1.25:1 up to ~320:1 via a staged coarse-to-fine cascade; never attempt direct matching across an extreme ratio.
acceptance_criteria: A direct OHRC<->IIRS request is intercepted and routed through TMC-2; composed transform matches the analytic composition.

description: Human-readable evaluation output carrying all PS-named metrics plus the pipeline path taken, control-gate results, confidence tier and provenance.
acceptance_criteria: make report emits a self-contained HTML; refuses to render with empty control gates.

description: The 'software' deliverable: a documented CLI exposing register / benchmark / ablate / report / demo.
acceptance_criteria: --help documents every flag; register runs end-to-end and writes a run directory.

description: Genuine namespace-aware PDS4 parsing of product ID, array dims, dtype, GSD, corner lat/lon (OHRC carries two quality levels), solar geometry and acquisition time. The single most commonly claimed-but-stubbed component across the ~49 competitor repos.
source: Research S34 (implementation stack), S14.2, failure mode #15
acceptance_criteria: Passes tests/test_pds_real.py on real OHRC + TMC-2 + IIRS labels with >=6 verified fields.

description: ODL keyword parsing for SELENE/Kaguya and older NASA archives: OBJECT=IMAGE blocks, LINES, LINE_SAMPLES, SAMPLE_BITS, SAMPLE_TYPE, RECORD_BYTES, ^IMAGE pointer offset, unit suffixes.
acceptance_criteria: Real SELENE TC .lbl round-trips; ^IMAGE offset correctly locates pixel data.

description: np.memmap reads using dtype, shape, endianness and offset taken FROM THE LABEL, never guessed. Windowed reads so multi-GB products are never fully loaded.
source: Research S17 (real product IDs and shapes)
acceptance_criteria: 1 KB window from a multi-GB product in <100 ms; shape assertion matches label.

description: Test asserting real label FIELDS were read, not merely that pixels loaded. A parser that silently falls back to cv2.imread must fail this test.
source: Research failure mode #15 (confirmed in >=2 competitor repos)
acceptance_criteria: Truncated label raises PdsParseError; label_fields_verified has >=6 True entries.

description: Config-driven registry of GSD, bands, swath, spectral range and dtype for all 7 instruments; product-ID-based instrument auto-detection; gsd_ratio() used by the regime selector and cascade planner.
acceptance_criteria: gsd_ratio('OHRC','IIRS') ~= 320; all 7 instruments resolve from product IDs.

description: Mandatory tiling with overlap. Real products reach 191483x4000 (TMC-2), 79796x12000 (OHRC), 104448x5000 (CDR NAC) - no whole-scene inference is possible.
source: Research S34: 'tiling is mandatory, not optional'
acceptance_criteria: Tiles enumerate lazily with bounded memory; tile_to_global round-trips exactly.

description: Selenographic CRS handling and an explicit reprojection step. Raw/calibrated CH-2 products carry corner lat/lon only, with NO pre-applied map projection - it must never be assumed implicit.
acceptance_criteria: Reproject-and-back returns corner coordinates within 1e-6 deg.

description: Build shapely polygons from corner lat/lon, intersect, and reject pairs below a minimum overlap fraction BEFORE any matcher is invoked.
acceptance_criteria: A non-overlapping pair is rejected with a clear reason and zero matcher calls.

description: Query the Orbital Data Explorer REST API for reference products overlapping a given CH-2 footprint. Free, no login, confirmed anonymous access.
acceptance_criteria: Returns >=1 real NAC product ID for a known lunar bounding box.

description: Per-scene and where possible per-pixel incidence, emission and phase angle from label fields, or SPICE-derived (mirroring ISIS3 phocube). GeometryLayers.source records which path was used.
source: Research S6, S29 (metadata sufficiency verified at archive-doc level)
acceptance_criteria: On a real label, incidence/azimuth are read not defaulted; source=='label'.

description: Fetch and window LOLA (118 m/px global), SLDEM2015 (59 m/px, +/-60 deg lat) and Kaguya ARD Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs from s3://astrogeo-ard (no AWS account needed, --no-sign-request).
acceptance_criteria: Returns an elevation array co-registered to a scene footprint, with DEM source recorded.

description: Derive per-pixel slope and aspect rasters. These are the direct input to the geometry-guided outlier filter - the project's novel layer.
acceptance_criteria: Slope of a synthetic constant-gradient DEM equals the analytic value within 0.1 deg.

description: Never trust a single metadata source. Label-derived geometry is always cross-validated against an independent DEM reprojection, and the disagreement is reported as an explicit uncertainty bound.
acceptance_criteria: A synthetic injected label error is caught by the DEM cross-check.

feature: Scale-ratio pre-flight and scale sanity check
description: Pre-flight comparison of the requested pair's GSD ratio against validated matcher ranges; post-estimation comparison of the ESTIMATED scale against the known GSD ratio, rejecting estimates that disagree.
acceptance_criteria: A deliberately wrong-scale match set is rejected with a named reason.

description: Automated fetchers for the no-login sources (LROC PDS, ODE, JAXA DARTS, USGS ARD/STAC) plus a documented manual click-path for PRADAN, whose mandatory Keycloak SSO cannot be scripted.
source: Research S15 (22 verified free sources; PRADAN login is the one friction point)
acceptance_criteria: One real product from each of CH-2, LRO NAC, SELENE TC and a DEM present in data/raw with checksums.

description: Every downloaded product recorded with size and checksum in a committed manifest, so any reported number traces back to exact bytes.
acceptance_criteria: Two runs on the same inputs produce identical manifest entries.

description: Contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalisation plus percentile stretch and float32 0..1 normalisation. Ablation Experiment 1's primary component.
acceptance_criteria: CLAHE measurably raises local contrast in a shadowed crop; output conforms to ImagePlane.

description: Multi-scale multi-orientation Log-Gabor bank producing phase congruency and maximum-index maps. Survives nonlinear radiometric differences between sensors and does not depend on strong local gradients.
source: Research S8, S22, S28 (RIFT/MIND family front end)
acceptance_criteria: PC maps of an image and its gamma-shifted twin correlate >0.9 where raw intensity correlation is much lower.

description: Modality-independent self-similarity representation, directly portable to the OHRC(panchromatic) vs IIRS(hyperspectral) pairing.
acceptance_criteria: Cross-modal synthetic pair matches better on MIND representation than on raw intensity.

description: Estimate signal-to-noise per IIRS band and drop low-SNR bands before any feature extraction.
acceptance_criteria: Per-band SNR computed on a real IIRS cube; selected band list logged.

description: Synthesise a panchromatic-equivalent plane from high-SNR IIRS bands instead of matching raw hyperspectral cubes. No single IIRS band corresponds to a panchromatic response; two independent teams measured 0 inliers matching raw cubes.
acceptance_criteria: Composite yields a higher keypoint count than the best single band on a real IIRS cube.

description: Region-level intensity variance plus near-zero-illumination thresholding, optionally cross-checked against incidence angle. Shadowed regions are excluded from primary matching and treated as a separate low-confidence tier.
acceptance_criteria: On a crater-interior crop, mask IoU >0.7 against a hand-drawn mask.

description: Texture scoring (gradient energy / entropy) that triggers the phase-congruency fallback when classical detectors would find too few stable keypoints on low-relief mare.
acceptance_criteria: A flat mare crop scores low texture and triggers the fallback path.

description: Autocorrelation-based repetitiveness scoring that drives a stricter Lowe ratio threshold in crater fields and ejecta patterns where local self-similarity causes false correspondences.
acceptance_criteria: A crater-field crop scores high repetitiveness and receives a tightened threshold.

description: Uniform Matcher protocol (name, licence, needs_gpu, match()) with a registry, so matchers are swappable and ablatable without touching the pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Three different matchers register and run through the identical call path.

description: The field's own documented baseline and our ablation floor. Every real lunar registration paper uses it as the comparison floor.
acceptance_criteria: Recovers a known synthetic homography to <1 px RMSE.

description: Additional classical detectors for comparison. AKAZE is competitive with SIFT near the equator; ORB is the weakest scale-invariance choice here and is included only for completeness.
acceptance_criteria: All three run and are selectable via config.

description: Radiation-variation-insensitive feature transform built on the phase-congruency/MIM maps. Purpose-built for nonlinear radiometric differences; a 2025 benchmark found classical RIFT beating the best deep method at high resolution. Reference implementation is MATLAB and needs porting - budget for it.
source: Research S22, S28 architecture F, S14.1
acceptance_criteria: Beats SIFT on a synthetic cross-modal pair by inlier ratio.

description: Apache-2.0 including weights, fastest learned matcher, CPU-capable, strong non-lunar satellite-stereo evidence. This is the deliverable's default learned path precisely because it is licence-clean.
source: Research S34, S35 licence audit, S28 architecture D
acceptance_criteria: Runs on CPU and GPU; beats SIFT on a synthetic illumination-shifted pair.

description: Dense transformer matching, strong on low-texture. Must NOT be deployed vanilla for extreme illumination - documented to fail near-completely at very low sun elevation on Mars-analog terrain without geometry-aided augmentation.
source: Research S21, S28 architecture C, failure mode #17
acceptance_criteria: Runs via kornia; routed only to non-extreme-illumination regimes by the selector.

description: Apache-2.0, real-time webcam-capable, with a real registration demo. The safety net if the demo machine has no GPU.
acceptance_criteria: Full pipeline completes on CPU within the demo time budget.

description: SuperGlue has the strongest direct real-Chandrayaan-2 evidence of any method - lowest RMSE and fastest runtime among five methods tested, and no polar degradation where classical methods degraded. We benchmark against it honestly, but its Magic Leap licence is non-commercial research only, so it is NEVER in the shipped path.
source: Research S3.1, S21, S35 licence audit, failure mode #14
acceptance_criteria: Import raises LicenceRestrictedError under ship_mode: true; outputs land in an excluded directory.

description: ship_mode: true blocks construction of any non-permissive matcher; CI runs a dependency licence check; R2D2 (CC BY-NC-SA, share-alike) is excluded entirely.
acceptance_criteria: tests/test_licence_gate.py proves restricted matchers cannot be instantiated in ship mode.

description: Route to a matcher based on extracted incidence angle, scale ratio and modality rather than hardcoding one method. The evidence is genuinely regime-dependent: SuperGlue-class wins at lunar poles, classical RIFT wins at high resolution in a separate benchmark; neither generalises universally.
source: Research S28 architecture F, S23 method-selection conclusion, S39 Q3
acceptance_criteria: A polar pair routes to the polar path; an extreme-scale request routes to the cascade, never a direct match.

description: Staged coarse-to-fine bridging: OHRC->TMC-2 (~20:1) -> SELENE TC (~2:1) or IIRS (~16:1) -> LRO NAC/WAC. No matcher in the literature has documented evaluation at 100x+ ratios; every real lunar paper chose resolution-matched pairs. Includes per-hop uncertainty propagation.
source: Research S7, S28 architecture H, Opportunity #8, failure mode #3
acceptance_criteria: Direct OHRC<->IIRS is intercepted and routed via TMC-2; composed transform matches the analytic composition.

description: Register OHRC to LRO NAC first for absolute geolocation control (the only pairing with strong repeated real evidence), then tie TMC-2 and IIRS into that same frame via their internal geometric relationship to OHRC - same spacecraft, same orbit, near-simultaneous acquisition. FLAGGED AS A DESIGN HYPOTHESIS to validate during the build, not a literature-backed finding.
acceptance_criteria: Bridge mode runs and its result is reported separately from the direct-registration result.

feature: ASIFT-style affine simulation for extreme rotation
description: Orientation-histogram sanity check pre-RANSAC; on failure, run affine simulation or switch to a rotation-invariant descriptor. Pushbroom sensor geometry and orbit-track differences between missions produce large rotations.
acceptance_criteria: A 60 deg rotated synthetic pair that plain SIFT fails on is recovered.

feature: DEM/SPICE coarse geolocation prior for large displacement
description: On match-count collapse at the default search radius, widen the search using a DEM/SPICE-derived coarse geolocation prior before fine matching.
acceptance_criteria: A pair with injected 500 px geolocation error still registers after the prior is applied.

feature: Lowe ratio test + mutual nearest neighbour
description: The cheap robustness floor every serious implementation uses at minimum.
acceptance_criteria: Both filters demonstrably reduce outlier fraction on a fixture.

description: Modern robust estimators that remove RANSAC's manual inlier threshold via sigma-consensus.
acceptance_criteria: Beats plain RANSAC on a synthetic set with 70% outliers.

feature: TPS / piecewise transform for local relief
description: Thin-plate-spline and piecewise models handle local non-rigid distortion from crater-driven terrain relief that a single global homography cannot.
acceptance_criteria: TPS reduces residual error vs homography on a synthetic relief-distorted pair.

description: Sample DEM slope/aspect and incidence/emission/phase at both endpoints of each candidate match; reject geometrically implausible matches; reweight survivors by geometric plausibility into MAGSAC; use DEM consistency to disambiguate repetitive terrain. No source demonstrates a general runtime pipeline doing this for cross-sensor lunar images - it is the most defensible novel component.
source: Research S29, Opportunity #6, S28 architecture G-as-filter
acceptance_criteria: On a repetitive-crater-field subset, false-positive inliers drop measurably vs RANSAC-only; INLIER PRECISION is the reported metric (Ablation Exp 3).

description: Steps 1-2 of the spatial uniformity algorithm: NxN grid adaptive to image size and match density; keep only the top-k highest-confidence matches per cell so dense regions cannot dominate RANSAC consensus.
acceptance_criteria: Over-dense regions are thinned; per-cell counts never exceed k.

description: Step 3: for cells with zero matches after the primary pass, run a lower-threshold secondary pass restricted to that cell's local region, avoiding the PS-illustrated dense-cluster-plus-empty-regions failure.
acceptance_criteria: Coverage improves after the secondary pass on a fixture with deliberate empty regions.

description: Step 5: triangulate the final inlier set and flag any triangle above an area threshold as an under-covered region - a second, complementary coverage diagnostic beside grid occupancy.
acceptance_criteria: max_delaunay_gap_px populated; correlates inversely with spatial_coverage on fixtures.

description: Alternative coverage-optimising selector for comparison against grid retention.
acceptance_criteria: Selectable via config; compared against grid retention in the report.

description: Fit a parabola to the normalised cross-correlation surface around each integer-pixel match to interpolate the sub-pixel peak.
source: Research S31 (confirmed working in real competitor code)
acceptance_criteria: Recovers a known sub-pixel shift to <0.1 px on the fixture.

description: Fourier / log-polar phase correlation for sub-pixel AND scale residual estimation after the primary match.
acceptance_criteria: Residual shift after correction is smaller than before, measured on the fixture.

description: Standard OpenCV iterative sub-pixel corner refinement as a third independent method.
acceptance_criteria: Runs and is included in the sub-pixel method comparison table.

description: Refines the GLOBAL transform post-match rather than individual point locations - a structurally different fourth method.
acceptance_criteria: Global RMSE decreases after refinement on real data.

description: Apply a KNOWN sub-pixel shift to a real CH-2 image and measure recovery error against that exactly-known shift. The only honest way to prove sub-pixel accuracy when no public sub-pixel ground truth exists.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics.subpixel_recovery_err_px populated from a real measurement on real imagery.

description: HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW / REJECTED tiers thresholded on inlier count, ratio, coverage and gate results. A RANSAC 'success' with a low true-inlier count is not unconditionally trustworthy.
source: Research S28, failure mode #12, S39 Q37
acceptance_criteria: A deliberately impossible pair returns REJECTED with a populated failure_modes list, exiting 0.

description: Match a constant-grey image against the reference. Near-zero inliers must result; a 'success' here means the pipeline is broken.
source: Research failure mode #19 (a competitor's real shared-zero-mask bug produced fake 100% inlier rates)
acceptance_criteria: Gate runs on every benchmark execution and is recorded in RegistrationResult.gates.

description: Apply a known 5 px shift; the recovered transform must move by ~5 px - not 0 (insensitive) and not 50 (unstable).
source: Research S32 failure mode #19 detection column
acceptance_criteria: Gate result recorded; a deliberately broken pipeline fails it.

feature: Control gate: shared-mask / aliasing guard + identity + noise + scale sanity
description: Assert source and reference masks are distinct objects; match an image against itself (RMSE~0, ratio~1); match pure noise (near-zero inliers); verify estimated scale against the known GSD ratio.
acceptance_criteria: All four gates run and are recorded on every benchmark execution.

feature: Quality gating - refuse to report without gates
description: report.py refuses to render a result whose gates dict is empty. A run without control gates is not a valid result.
source: Research S28 honest quality gating; honesty rule H4
acceptance_criteria: A mocked empty-gates result raises rather than rendering.

description: No existing benchmark fits: HPatches/MegaDepth/IMC/ETH3D are terrestrial, SEN1-2/3MOS/MultiResSAR are Earth SAR-optical, and the closest lunar precedent was internal to one paper and never published as reusable. Easy=OHRC<->NAC, Medium=IIRS<->WAC, Hard=TMC-2<->NAC/SELENE-TC (THE contribution), Extreme=OHRC<->IIRS (included to report degradation honestly, not to claim success).
source: Research S18 (no benchmark fits), S19 (tier design)
acceptance_criteria: make bench produces per-tier RMSE / inlier count / ratio / coverage / runtime plus all gate results.

description: Ground truth from PDS4 label geometry (OHRC's two corner-quality levels both used), cross-validated against an independent DEM reprojection, hand-verified on a held-out subset, with conservative per-tier error bounds. Hard tier's bound is deliberately left open since no precedent exists.
acceptance_criteria: Label-derived and DEM-derived transforms are reported together with their disagreement.

description: Baseline(SIFT+RANSAC) -> +illumination normalisation -> +deep features -> +geometry constraints -> +cascade -> +sub-pixel -> Final. Structured to test whether each component HELPS, not to assume it does. Experiments 3 and 4 are expected to matter most.
acceptance_criteria: make ablate produces a per-stage table; a stage that does not help is reported as not helping.

description: Place our measured Easy/Medium numbers next to published external baselines, each tagged source='external' vs 'measured'. Easy/Medium are the credibility floor that earns the right to be believed on Hard/Extreme where no external precedent exists.
source: Research S33, S40 expected results, honesty rule H5
acceptance_criteria: Report renders both columns distinctly; no external number is ever presented as ours.

description: Measure our own end-to-end pipeline time including tiling and preprocessing. Published per-method figures (LightGlue 44.2 ms/pair, SuperGlue ~69 ms, LoFTR 116-130 ms) are planning inputs only, never reported as ours.
source: Research S34 inference speed, S39 Q26
acceptance_criteria: Metrics.runtime_s measured per run; end-to-end time reported separately from per-matcher time.

description: All 20 documented failure modes with cause, detection hook and mitigation; every observed runtime failure tagged to a mode ID and surfaced in RegistrationResult.failure_modes.
source: Research S32 (20 failure modes, drawn from real competitor failures not invented generically)
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 20 modes has a detection hook or an explicit 'manual detection only' note.

description: Input product IDs + checksums, config hash, package versions, git commit SHA, UTC timestamp, host/GPU, and the ship_mode flag embedded in every output.
source: Research S40 reproducibility checklist; honesty rule H2
acceptance_criteria: Two runs from the same commit and inputs produce identical manifests except the timestamp.

description: Source and reference shown together with the sun-angle delta annotated. The visual that makes the problem obvious in five seconds - the demo opens on this.
acceptance_criteria: Renders from both a mock and a real RegistrationResult.

description: Inliers vs outliers colour-coded across the pair.
acceptance_criteria: Renders; inlier/outlier counts in the figure match Metrics.

description: NxN grid occupancy heatmap - the figure that SHOWS the PS's uniformity mandate being met rather than merely asserting it.
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap cell count matches the configured grid; occupancy fraction matches Metrics.spatial_coverage.

description: Interactive swipe and checkerboard overlay showing pre- vs post-registration alignment.
acceptance_criteria: Renders in the report and in the UI.

description: Jinja2 report: inputs -> pipeline path taken (regime, cascade stages) -> the four PS metrics -> coverage figure -> sub-pixel validation -> control-gate table -> confidence tier -> failure modes -> provenance. None renders as 'not measured', never as blank or zero.
acceptance_criteria: Self-contained HTML; refuses to render on empty gates; every number carries a source tag.

description: POST /register (async job), GET /runs/{id} (status + metrics), GET /runs/{id}/assets/{name}, GET /pairs (curated benchmark pairs).
acceptance_criteria: Returns a valid result for a curated pair within the configured timeout; streams progress.

description: Pick a curated pair or upload; live progress showing which regime/cascade path was chosen; results screen with all four visuals, metric cards and a confidence-tier badge. A REJECTED run renders an explicit 'REJECTED - reason' panel; hiding failures in the UI would undo the entire honesty discipline.
source: Research S37 (modal competitor is 'basic web UI'), honesty rule H3
acceptance_criteria: Full flow works OFFLINE from cached runs - assume venue Wi-Fi fails.

description: The reproducible demo: real CH-2 + real reference with visible sun-angle difference -> SIFT failing -> our method -> live metrics -> the TMC-2<->SELENE TC differentiator segment -> closing solved-vs-added slide. Every bracketed number replaced with our own measurement from the same protocol.
acceptance_criteria: Runs twice in a row from a clean clone with no network, under 3 minutes.

description: All 40 anticipated judge questions answered with this project's own evidence and measured numbers, not generic CV-course answers.
acceptance_criteria: Every answer either cites a measured number or explicitly states the limitation.

description: Dataset access notes (PRADAN needs SSO; NASA/JAXA/USGS do not), pinned environment, licence-audited dependencies, weights provenance, training procedure stated honestly, evaluation scripts, ground-truth derivation, expected per-tier results.
source: Research S40 reproducibility checklist; honesty rules H2/H6
acceptance_criteria: bash scripts/reproduce.sh regenerates every reported number from a clean clone.

description: Component-by-component licence table plus the explicit statement that the deliverable is buildable entirely from Apache-2.0/MIT/BSD components, with non-commercial matchers confined to an excluded internal benchmark. A deliberate design choice to remove licence risk from anything ISRO might redistribute.
source: Research S35 licence audit, S39 Q29/Q30
acceptance_criteria: Every dependency in requirements.lock appears with its licence and a ship/no-ship verdict.

description: Pipeline diagram, module ownership table, the regime routing table and the cascade stage graph.
acceptance_criteria: Diagram matches the shipped module layout; reviewed by all three members.

description: make setup/test/bench/ablate/demo/report; GitHub Actions runs tests on every PR and blocks merge on red; lockfile committed.
acceptance_criteria: A red build blocks merge; lockfile reproduces the environment.

description: Automated enforcement of rules H1-H6: no hardcoded metric literals in return paths, Metrics defaults to None, report requires source tags and non-empty gates.
